assumptions.choice: The supplied 15-minute bars are aggregated into 30-, 60-, and 120-minute candles from the first bar of each trading day; incomplete end-of-day aggregates are not evaluated.
assumptions.reason: The harness provides only one 15-minute feed and does not specify higher-timeframe session alignment.

assumptions.choice: A 120-minute Bullish Engulfing triggers an entry only when the Bullish Engulfing counts within that same 120-minute window increase strictly at every drill-down step: 60 > 120, 30 > 60, and 15 > 30.
assumptions.reason: This applies the required recursive search across all listed consecutive timeframes and places the signal on the lowest specified entry timeframe.

assumptions.choice: A lower-timeframe pattern is counted when its completing candle ends within the triggering 120-minute window, even if its preceding candle began before that window.
assumptions.reason: This permits all lower-candle completions in the stated period to be searched and counted.

assumptions.choice: ATR uses period 14 on the 15-minute entry timeframe.
assumptions.reason: The specification requires ATR but does not state a period; 14 is the conventional ATR default.

assumptions.choice: The pattern and opposite_pattern parameters may be replaced with callables accepting previous and current candle dictionaries; absent replacements they are Bullish and Bearish Engulfing respectively.
assumptions.reason: Backtrader has no universal standard-candlestick-pattern selector, so callable parameters make replacement direct without changing the aggregation logic.

assumptions.choice: Orders use Backtrader Close orders as the closest available representation of execution at the candle close.
assumptions.reason: With the fixed harness and no specified cheat-on-close broker setting, an order submitted after observing a completed candle cannot be guaranteed to fill at that same candle's close.

assumptions.choice: If both the stop and profit target are reachable in one 15-minute bar, the stop condition is evaluated first.
assumptions.reason: OHLCV bars do not provide the intrabar price path needed to determine which level was reached first.
